title: UFO enters east field below helicopter and exits from mesa

tellings.quote: He also described a time where a UFO dropped down from the sky, entered the east field portion of the ranch below a helicopter, and then exited from a mesa.

plain: A podcast host named Jesse Michels passes on a story from Brandon Fugal, the owner of Skinwalker Ranch, a property in Utah known for reports of strange happenings. According to Michels, Fugal described a UFO that dropped out of the sky, flew into the ranch's east field below a helicopter, and then left by way of a mesa, a flat-topped hill. If true, it would mean an unknown craft moving in and out of the land itself, right under an aircraft.
